title: Retire the dead deploy-staging-live job and its master push trigger from the nonprod deploy workflow
summary: Retired the dead deploy-staging-live job and master push trigger from .github/workflows/nonprod-deploy.yml, along with staging-live dispatch choices and deleted staging repository variables references across workflow, tests, and documentation. Dev deployment jobs and assertions remain byte-identical.

grep_checks.command: git grep -n deploy-staging-live -- .github scripts services tests

git grep -nE 'environment=staging-live|automatic on .master. pushes|read by the staging-live deploy job|and the staging-live deploy|Staging-live promotion is manual|rolled back independently by manually' -- docs/deployment/nonprod-ci-cd.md
git grep -nE 'staging-auto|push on .master.. and|cancel-in-progress. true only for push' -- docs/conventions/GIT_WORKFLOW.md

acceptance_checklist.criterion: 1. At the delivered head .github/workflows/nonprod-deploy.yml parses as YAML with exactly the three jobs deploy-dev and coordinate-dev-release and isolated-l12-provider-qualification; workflow_dispatch is its only trigger; the environment input offers only dev; the component input offers only auto and root and bff; and no allow_example_env input exists

In .github/workflows/nonprod-deploy.yml the concurrency block reads exactly group: pantheon-nonprod-deploy-${{ inputs.environment }} followed by cancel-in-progress: false; the run-name line equals the merge-base run-name line with only the text github.event.head_commit.message || removed; the component description reads Stack slice to deploy; auto maps to dev/root and the ref description reads Dev requires the exact current Pantheon dev SHA.
